acceptanceCriteria: Either a bounded, documented set of gate-heading aliases is recognised with tests, or the spec records that only Verify headings count and why.
Declared-gate output is observed live on at least two beamfall repositories and recorded.
body: Residual from the impact-gates-1021t lane (PR #1512, V1-2071/V1-1848, NGI-V0-060..062, AFP-V0-196). The shared declared-command parser (internal/projectprofile/verify.go) only accepts an exact 'Verify' heading or an inline **Verify:** line. Repositories that declare their gate under headings such as '## Build / gate' get no declared gate. Live verification of declared-gate behaviour on the beamfall repositories was not run.
title: Declared Verify gates: a '## Build / gate' heading is not recognised; only an exact Verify heading or inline **Verify:** line counts, and live beamfall-repo verification is NOT_RUN
